import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

path = "budget.xlsx"
NS = {
    "main": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
    "rel": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
    "pkgrel": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships",
}

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("Archive entries:", names)
    print()

    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = wb.find("main:sheets", NS)
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {}
    for rel in rels:
        rel_map[rel.get("Id")] = rel.get("Target")

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
        ss = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in ss.findall("main:si", NS):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
            shared.append(text)

    for sheet in sheets.findall("main:sheet", NS):
        name = sheet.get("name")
        rid = sheet.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id")
        target = rel_map.get(rid, "")
        if not target.startswith("xl/"):
            target = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/")
        print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (path {target}) ===")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in root.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row"):
            cells = []
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find("main:v", NS)
                f = c.find("main:f", NS)
                if f is not None:
                    val = "=" + (f.text or "")
                elif v is None:
                    val = ""
                elif t == "s":
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif t == "inlineStr":
                    is_ = c.find("main:is", NS)
                    val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in is_.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
                else:
                    val = v.text
                cells.append((ref, val))
            print(cells)
        print()

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

path = "budget.xlsx"
MAIN = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
NS = {"main": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}
out = []
summary = []

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {rel.get("Id"): rel.get("Target") for rel in rels}

    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
        ss = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in ss.findall("main:si", NS):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(MAIN + "t"))
            shared.append(text)

    for sheet in wb.findall("main:sheet", NS):
        name = sheet.get("name")
        rid = sheet.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id")
        target = rel_map.get(rid, "")
        if not target.startswith("xl/"):
            target = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/")
        out.append(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        numeric = []
        for row in root.iter(MAIN + "row"):
            cells = []
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find(MAIN + "v")
                f = c.find(MAIN + "f")
                if f is not None:
                    val = "=" + (f.text or "")
                elif v is None:
                    val = ""
                elif t == "s":
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif t == "inlineStr":
                    is_ = c.find(MAIN + "is")
                    val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in is_.iter(MAIN + "t"))
                else:
                    val = v.text
                    try:
                        numeric.append((ref, float(v.text)))
                    except (TypeError, ValueError):
                        pass
                cells.append((ref, val))
            out.append(repr(cells))
        out.append("Numeric cells: " + repr(numeric))
        out.append("Sum of all numeric cells: " + repr(sum(n for _, n in numeric)))
        out.append("")
        summary.append(f"Sheet {name}: numeric={numeric} sum={sum(n for _, n in numeric)}")

text = "\n".join(out)
with open("budget_analysis.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(text)
raise RuntimeError("BUDGET_DUMP:\n" + "\n".join(summary))
